WITH cte_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSserved
  FROM schools
  WHERE NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND GSserved LIKE '%12%'
),

cte_sat_takers AS (
  SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS total_takers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),

cte_joined AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.GSserved, COALESCE(st.total_takers, 0) AS total_takers
  FROM cte_schools s
  LEFT JOIN cte_sat_takers st
  ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
  WHERE COALESCE(st.total_takers, 0) = 0
),

cte_earliest_grade AS (
  SELECT MIN(CASE 
               WHEN GSserved LIKE '%PK%' THEN 0
               WHEN GSserved LIKE '%KG%' THEN 1
               ELSE CAST(GSserved AS INTEGER)
             END) AS earliest_grade
  FROM cte_joined
),

cte_filtered AS (
  SELECT School, GSserved
  FROM cte_joined, cte_earliest_grade
  WHERE CASE 
          WHEN GSserved LIKE '%PK%' THEN 0
          WHEN GSserved LIKE '%KG%' THEN 1
          ELSE CAST(GSserved AS INTEGER)
        END = earliest_grade
)

FROM cte_filtered
ORDER BY School ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH district_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School, GSoffered AS grade_span
    FROM schools
    WHERE NCESDist = '0613360'
      AND ClosedDate IS NULL
      AND GSoffered LIKE '%12%'
),
sat_counts AS (
    SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS test_takers
    FROM satscores
    WHERE cds IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM district_schools)
    GROUP BY cds
),
zero_sat_schools AS (
    SELECT d.CDSCode, d.School, d.grade_span
    FROM district_schools d
    LEFT JOIN sat_counts s ON d.CDSCode = s.cds
    WHERE (s.test_takers IS NULL OR s.test_takers = 0)
),
grade_order AS (
    SELECT 'Preschool' AS grade_name, 1 AS grade_num UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Kindergarten', 2 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 1', 3 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 2', 4 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 3', 5 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 4', 6 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 5', 7 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 6', 8 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 7', 9 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 8', 10 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 9', 11 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 10', 12 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 11', 13 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 12', 14
),
parse_start_grade AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School, grade_span,
      CASE
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Preschool-%' THEN 'Preschool'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Kindergarten-%' THEN 'Kindergarten'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 1-%' THEN 'Grade 1'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 2-%' THEN 'Grade 2'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 3-%' THEN 'Grade 3'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 4-%' THEN 'Grade 4'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 5-%' THEN 'Grade 5'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 6-%' THEN 'Grade 6'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 7-%' THEN 'Grade 7'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 8-%' THEN 'Grade 8'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 9-%' THEN 'Grade 9'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 10-%' THEN 'Grade 10'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 11-%' THEN 'Grade 11'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 12-%' THEN 'Grade 12'
        ELSE NULL
      END AS start_grade
    FROM zero_sat_schools
),
start_grade_num AS (
    SELECT p.CDSCode, p.School, p.start_grade, g.grade_num, p.grade_span
    FROM parse_start_grade p
    LEFT JOIN grade_order g ON p.start_grade = g.grade_name
),
min_grade AS (
    SELECT MIN(grade_num) AS min_grade_num FROM start_grade_num
)
SELECT School, grade_span
FROM start_grade_num, min_grade
WHERE grade_num = min_grade_num
ORDER BY School ASC
LIMIT 1000;

-- Identify candidate schools with special needs related names
 CandidateSchools AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.GSoffered,
    s.GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN s.GSoffered IS NULL THEN 'K'  -- assume K if no data
      ELSE substr(s.GSoffered, 1, 1)
    END AS start_grade_code
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.State = 'CA' AND (
    lower(s.School) LIKE '%deaf%' OR
    lower(s.School) LIKE '%blind%' OR
    lower(s.School) LIKE '%special%'
  )
),
GradeRanks AS (
  SELECT cs.*, gr.rank AS start_rank
  FROM CandidateSchools cs
  LEFT JOIN GradeRank gr ON cs.start_grade_code = gr.grade
),
SATCounts AS (
  SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS SATtesters
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'overall'
  GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT 
  gr.School,
  gr.start_grade_code AS EarliestGradeLevel,
  gr.GSserved AS K12Enrollment,
  COALESCE(s.SATtesters, 0) AS SATTestTakers
FROM GradeRanks gr
LEFT JOIN SATCounts s ON gr.CDSCode = s.cds
ORDER BY gr.start_rank DESC, gr.GSserved DESC, gr.School ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH ActiveCharterCountySchools AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, f.[Charter Funding Type] AS FundingType
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Charter = 1
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.DOCType = 'County'
    AND f.[Charter Funding Type] IN ('directly funded', 'locally funded')
  GROUP BY s.CDSCode, f.[Charter Funding Type]
),
EnrollmentFRPM AS (
  SELECT FundingType,
         COUNT(DISTINCT a.CDSCode) AS OperatingSchools,
         SUM(f.[Enrollment (K-12)]) AS TotalEnrollmentK12,
         SUM(f.[FRPM Count (K-12)]) AS TotalFRPMEligibleK12
  FROM ActiveCharterCountySchools a
  JOIN frpm f ON a.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    AND a.FundingType = f.[Charter Funding Type]
  GROUP BY FundingType
)
SELECT FundingType,
       OperatingSchools AS CurrentlyOperatingSchools,
       TotalEnrollmentK12 AS TotalK12Enrollment,
       TotalFRPMEligibleK12 AS TotalFRPMEligibleK12Students
FROM EnrollmentFRPM
ORDER BY CASE FundingType WHEN 'directly funded' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH SetsWithTranslation AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.code, s.type
  FROM sets s
  JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
  WHERE st.translation IS NOT NULL AND st.translation != ''
), CountSets AS (
  SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS sets_with_translation
  FROM SetsWithTranslation
  GROUP BY type
), CountCards AS (
  SELECT s.type, COUNT(c.id) AS total_cards
  FROM sets s
  JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = s.code
  GROUP BY s.type
)
SELECT 
  type,
  COALESCE(sets_with_translation, 0) AS sets_with_translation,
  COALESCE(total_cards, 0) AS total_cards
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT type FROM sets
) all_types
LEFT JOIN CountSets USING(type)
LEFT JOIN CountCards USING(type)
ORDER BY type ASC;

WITH abyssal_sets AS (
  SELECT s.code AS set_code, s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate
  FROM sets s
  JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
),
first_abyssal_set AS (
  SELECT set_code, set_name
  FROM abyssal_sets
  WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MIN(releaseDate) FROM abyssal_sets)
  ORDER BY set_code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
most_recent_set AS (
  SELECT code AS set_code, name AS set_name
  FROM sets
  WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM sets)
  ORDER BY code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
target_sets AS (
  SELECT * FROM first_abyssal_set
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM most_recent_set
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    s.code AS set_code,
    COUNT(c.uuid) AS total_cards,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.convertedManaCost <= 3 AND c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND c.manaCost != '' THEN 1 END) AS cheap_cards
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE s.code IN (SELECT set_code FROM target_sets)
  GROUP BY s.code
)
SELECT
  t.set_name AS "Set Name",
  ROUND(CAST(c.cheap_cards AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / c.total_cards, 2) AS "% of Cards with CMC <= 3"
FROM counts c
JOIN target_sets t ON c.set_code = t.set_code;

WITH LatestBuildUpPlaySpeed AS (
  SELECT
    t.team_api_id,
    m.id AS match_id,
    MAX(ta.date) AS latest_date
  FROM
    Match m
    JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON m.home_team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
  WHERE
    ta.date <= m.date
  GROUP BY
    t.team_api_id, m.id
),

FastSpeedHomeWins AS (
  SELECT
    m.home_team_api_id,
    t.team_long_name,
    t.team_short_name
  FROM
    Match m
    JOIN LatestBuildUpPlaySpeed lb ON m.id = lb.match_id AND m.home_team_api_id = lb.team_api_id
    JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON ta.team_api_id = lb.team_api_id AND ta.date = lb.latest_date
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
  WHERE
    (m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal) >= 3
    AND ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
)

SELECT
  home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
  team_long_name,
  team_short_name,
  COUNT(*) AS fast_speed_3goal_wins
FROM
  FastSpeedHomeWins
GROUP BY
  home_team_api_id, team_long_name, team_short_name
HAVING
  fast_speed_3goal_wins = (
    SELECT
      MAX(win_count)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        home_team_api_id,
        COUNT(*) AS win_count
      FROM
        FastSpeedHomeWins
      GROUP BY home_team_api_id
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  fast_speed_3goal_wins DESC

treatment.sql:
WITH HomeWin3Plus AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS match_id,
    m.home_team_api_id,
    m.date AS match_date,
    m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal AS goal_diff
  FROM Match m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
),

FastSpeedBuildUp AS (
  SELECT
    ta.team_api_id,
    ta.date AS attr_date,
    ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
  WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
),

HomeWithFastBuildUp AS (
  SELECT
    hw.match_id,
    hw.home_team_api_id,
    hw.match_date
  FROM HomeWin3Plus hw
  JOIN FastSpeedBuildUp fs ON fs.team_api_id = hw.home_team_api_id
    AND fs.attr_date <= hw.match_date
  WHERE fs.attr_date = (
    SELECT MAX(fs2.attr_date)
    FROM FastSpeedBuildUp fs2
    WHERE fs2.team_api_id = hw.home_team_api_id
      AND fs2.attr_date <= hw.match_date
  )
),

CountingWinsByTeam AS (
  SELECT
    h.home_team_api_id,
    COUNT(*) AS fast_build_up_home_wins
  FROM HomeWithFastBuildUp h
  GROUP BY h.home_team_api_id
),

MaxWins AS (
  SELECT MAX(fast_build_up_home_wins) AS max_wins FROM CountingWinsByTeam
)

SELECT
  t.team_long_name AS club_name,
  t.team_short_name AS club_short_name,
  c.fast_build_up_home_wins
FROM CountingWinsByTeam c
JOIN MaxWins mw ON c.fast_build_up_home_wins = mw.max_wins
JOIN Team t ON c.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
ORDER BY club_name

WITH litomerice_region AS (

    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1996'
    GROUP BY a.account_id, district_name
), last_valid_trans AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, MAX(t.trans_date) AS last_date
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.trans_date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
), last_trans_id AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, MAX(t.trans_id) AS max_trans_id
    FROM trans t
    JOIN last_valid_trans lvt ON t.account_id = lvt.account_id AND t.trans_date = lvt.last_date
    GROUP BY t.account_id
), last_balance AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.amount AS balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN last_trans_id lti ON t.account_id = lti.account_id AND t.trans_id = lti.max_trans_id
), district_balance AS (
    SELECT a.district_name, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened, ROUND(AVG(lb.balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM accounts_1996 a
    JOIN last_balance lb ON a.account_id = lb.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_name
), region_avg AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(lb.balance), 2) AS region_avg_balance
    FROM accounts_1996 a
    JOIN last_balance lb ON a.account_id = lb.account_id
), max_avg_balance_district AS (
    SELECT district_name
    FROM district_balance
    WHERE avg_balance = (SELECT MAX(avg_balance) FROM district_balance)
    ORDER BY district_name
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT district_name, accounts_opened, avg_balance
FROM district_balance

UNION ALL

SELECT 'REGION_AVG' AS district_name, NULL AS accounts_opened, region_avg_balance AS avg_balance
FROM region_avg

UNION ALL

SELECT 'HIGHEST_AVG_BAL_DISTRICT' AS district_name, NULL AS accounts_opened, NULL AS avg_balance
FROM max_avg_balance_district

ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN district_name = 'REGION_AVG' THEN 2
    WHEN district_name = 'HIGHEST_AVG_BAL_DISTRICT' THEN 3

         MAX(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_repaying
  FROM loan
  WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),

Transactions1997 AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'cash_withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
         MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),

LoanStanding AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         CASE
           WHEN loan_count = 0 THEN 'no loan'
           WHEN has_defaulted = 1 THEN 'defaulted'
           WHEN has_repaying = 1 THEN 'repaying'
           ELSE 'paid off'
         END AS loan_standing
  FROM LoansPerAccount
),

FinalProfiles AS (
  SELECT ao.account_id,
         ao.opening_date,
         ao.gender,
         CAST((julianday('1996-12-31') - julianday(ao.birth_date)) / 365 AS INTEGER) AS age_at_1996_12_31,
         COALESCE(cp.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
         COALESCE(lp.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
         ls.loan_standing,
         COALESCE(t.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count_1997,
         COALESCE(t.money_in, 0) AS money_in_1997,
         COALESCE(t.money_out, 0) AS money_out_1997,
         COALESCE(t.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance_1997
  FROM AccountOwner ao
  LEFT JOIN CardsPerAccount cp ON ao.account_id = cp.account_id
  LEFT JOIN LoansPerAccount lp ON ao.account_id = lp.account_id
  LEFT JOIN LoanStanding ls ON ao.account_id = ls.account_id
  LEFT JOIN Transactions1997 t ON ao.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE ao.opening_date <= '1996-12-31'
),

RankedProfiles AS (
  SELECT *,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance_1997 DESC, account_id ASC) AS peak_balance_rank
  FROM FinalProfiles
)

SELECT account_id,
       opening_date,
       gender,
       age_at_1996_12_31,
       card_count,
       loan_count,
       loan_standing,
       trans_count_1997 AS trans_count,
       money_in_1997 AS money_in,
       money_out_1997 AS money_out,
       peak_balance_1997 AS peak_balance,
       peak_balance_rank
FROM RankedProfiles
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;

WITH circuit_start_times AS (
    SELECT
        r.circuitId,
        c.name AS circuit_name,
        substr(IFNULL(r.time, '00:00:00'), 1, 2) AS start_hour,
        substr(IFNULL(r.time, '00:00:00'), 4, 2) AS start_minute,
        substr(IFNULL(r.time, '00:00:00'), 7, 2) AS start_second
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
),
start_times_seconds AS (
    SELECT
        circuitId,
        circuit_name,
        (CAST(start_hour AS INTEGER) * 3600) + (CAST(start_minute AS INTEGER) * 60) + CAST(start_second AS INTEGER) AS start_seconds
    FROM circuit_start_times
),
min_max_times AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(start_seconds) AS earliest_start_seconds,
        MAX(start_seconds) AS latest_start_seconds
    FROM start_times_seconds
),
earliest_circuits AS (
    SELECT circuit_name
    FROM start_times_seconds, min_max_times
    WHERE start_seconds = earliest_start_seconds
),
latest_circuits AS (
    SELECT circuit_name
    FROM start_times_seconds, min_max_times
    WHERE start_seconds = latest_start_seconds
)
SELECT
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuit_name, ', ') FROM earliest_circuits) AS earliest_circuits,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuit_name, ', ') FROM latest_circuits) AS latest_circuits,
    latest_start_seconds - earliest_start_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM min_max_times
LIMIT 1;

CircuitTimesInSeconds AS (

EarliestTime AS (

),

LatestTime AS (
  SELECT MAX(start_time_seconds) AS latest_start_time FROM CircuitTimesInSeconds
),

  WHERE start_time_seconds = earliest_start_time
),

LatestCircuits AS (

  FROM CircuitTimesInSeconds, LatestTime
  WHERE start_time_seconds = latest_start_time
),

TimeDifferenceSeconds AS (

  FROM EarliestTime, LatestTime
)

  (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ') FROM LatestCircuits) AS latest_circuits,
  (SELECT time_gap_seconds FROM TimeDifferenceSeconds) AS gap_in_seconds
;

WITH target_molecule AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'Y'
  LIMIT 1
), molecule_bonds AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  WHERE a.molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM target_molecule)
), hydrogen_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE c.bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM molecule_bonds)
    AND (a1.element = 'H' OR a2.element = 'H')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_bond_count
FROM hydrogen_bonds;

WITH NonCarcinogenicMolecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '-'
),
DoubleTripleBonds AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
    AND b.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM NonCarcinogenicMolecules)
),
ElementPairs AS (
  SELECT 
    a1.element AS element1,
    a2.element AS element2
  FROM DoubleTripleBonds dt
  JOIN atom a1 ON dt.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON dt.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN element1 = 'C' THEN element2 ELSE element1 END AS element,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM ElementPairs
WHERE element1 = 'C' OR element2 = 'C'
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

WITH non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '-'
), 
bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT b.bond_id, b.bond_type, b.molecule_id, a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, a2.atom_id AS atom2_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
  WHERE a1.atom_id < a2.atom_id
),
carbon_element_bonds AS (
  SELECT ba.bond_id, ba.bond_type, CASE
    WHEN a1.element = 'C' THEN a2.element
    WHEN a2.element = 'C' THEN a1.element
  END AS element
  FROM bonded_atoms ba
  JOIN atom a1 ON ba.atom1_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON ba.atom2_id = a2.atom_id
  JOIN non_carcinogenic_molecules nm ON ba.molecule_id = nm.molecule_id
  WHERE ((a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element != 'C') OR (a2.element = 'C' AND a1.element != 'C'))
    AND ba.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
)
SELECT element, COUNT(bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM carbon_element_bonds
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

WITH bond_atom_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        b.bond_type AS bond_kind,
        c.atom_id,
        c.atom_id2
    FROM
        bond b
    JOIN
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE
        b.molecule_id = 'TR377' AND
        b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
),
element_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        bond_kind,
        CASE
            WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element
            ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element
        END AS element_pair
    FROM
        bond_atom_pairs bap
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = bap.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = bap.atom_id2
),
bond_composition AS (
    SELECT
        bond_kind,
        COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
        COUNT(DISTINCT element_pair) AS num_element_pairs
    FROM
        element_pairs
    GROUP BY
        bond_kind
),
molecule_info AS (
    SELECT
        label AS carcinogenicity_label
    FROM
        molecule
    WHERE
        molecule_id = 'TR377'
)
SELECT
    bc.bond_kind,
    bc.num_bonds,
    bc.num_element_pairs,
    mi.carcinogenicity_label
FROM
    bond_composition bc
CROSS JOIN
    molecule_info mi
ORDER BY
    bc.num_bonds DESC,
    bc.bond_kind ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH metal_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE LOWER(element) IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
), single_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
), non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '-'
), valid_molecules AS (
  SELECT n.molecule_id
  FROM non_carcinogenic_molecules n
  JOIN metal_atoms m ON n.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  JOIN single_bond_molecules s ON m.molecule_id = s.molecule_id
)
SELECT molecule_id
FROM valid_molecules
ORDER BY molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH atom_bond_types AS (
  SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    a.element,
    b.bond_type
  FROM atom a
  JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
),
atom_bond_summary AS (
  SELECT
    atom_id,
    element,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS multiple_bond_count,
    COUNT(bond_type) AS total_bond_count
  FROM atom_bond_types
  GROUP BY atom_id, element
)
SELECT
  element,
  COUNT(*) AS num_atoms_only_single_bonds
FROM atom_bond_summary
WHERE total_bond_count > 0
  AND multiple_bond_count = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;

WITH atom_bond_types AS (
    SELECT c.atom_id, b.bond_type
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id, b.bond_type
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
),
single_bond_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM atom_bond_types
    GROUP BY atom_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
),
single_only_atoms_with_element AS (
    SELECT a.element, s.atom_id
    FROM single_bond_atoms s
    JOIN atom a ON s.atom_id = a.atom_id
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM single_only_atoms_with_element
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;

WITH TripleBondAtoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
  FROM atom
  JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
  JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
  WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
    AND (atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id OR atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2)
), ElementMoleculeCount AS (
  SELECT atom.element, COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM atom
  WHERE atom.element IN (SELECT element FROM TripleBondAtoms)
  GROUP BY atom.element
)
SELECT element AS element_symbol, molecule_count
FROM ElementMoleculeCount
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

WITH MolAtoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, element
  FROM atom
  WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR397')
), BondAtoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT atom_id AS atom_in_bond, bond_id FROM connected
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT atom_id2 AS atom_in_bond, bond_id FROM connected
), BondAtomsInMol AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT atom_in_bond
  FROM BondAtoms
  JOIN bond ON BondAtoms.bond_id = bond.bond_id
  WHERE bond.molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR397')
)
SELECT ma.element, COUNT(*) AS bonded_count
FROM MolAtoms ma
JOIN BondAtomsInMol ba ON ma.atom_id = ba.atom_in_bond
GROUP BY ma.element
ORDER BY ma.element ASC;
